A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Frequently asked questions

Are these the final RunBridge prices?+

No. The estimator uses editable example rates for planning. Commercial rates and billing terms will be published with the launch catalog.

How should I estimate text costs?+

Calculate input and output tokens separately using their respective rates. Add any model-specific charges and allow room for retries or longer responses.

Can I compare image and video costs directly?+

Only after aligning output settings. Resolution, duration, quality and supported inputs can materially affect the cost of a generation.

FROM ESTIMATE TO BUDGET

Count the whole workload.

Text cost

Input tokens × input rate
+ output tokens × output rate

Divide token counts by one million when your rates are quoted per 1M tokens.

Image & video cost

Billable output units
× the selected model’s unit rate

Check resolution, quality, duration and any additional model-specific charges.

Monthly plan

Cost per task
× expected monthly tasks

Include generation iterations and retries according to the applicable billing rules.
